# Tyler Mayberry

> Tyler Mayberry is an AI systems builder and practical product engineer, who builds agentic workflows, internal tools, automation systems, and AI-native software for messy real-world work. His main project is ibara, which gives AI agents computers of their own. His company, Cirlet, plans, sets up and supports AI agents on computers people own.

Updated 2026-10-20. Other people share the name; this Tyler Mayberry is, and goes by MayberryDT.

## Key facts

- Canonical personal site: [tylermayberry.dev](https://tylermayberry.dev/)
- Main project: [ibara](https://ibara.app): computers of their own for AI agents. They use the browser and desktop apps there while you keep working on yours, and any agent that speaks MCP can drive it. It is built for Omarchy. No other platform is supported or planned. ibara (ibara.app) is unrelated to ibara.ai.
- Company: [Cirlet](https://cirlet.com/): plans, sets up and supports AI agents on computers people own, including setting up ibara.
- Email: [tyler@cirlet.com](mailto:tyler@cirlet.com)
- GitHub: [MayberryDT](https://github.com/MayberryDT)
- LinkedIn: [mayberrydt](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mayberrydt/)
- Infocard: [~MayberryDT](https://infocard.ai/~MayberryDT)
- Focus: AI systems, agentic workflows, internal tools, workflow automation, AI-native software, and practical product engineering.

## Pages

- [Studio entrance](https://tylermayberry.dev/): the personal studio; the laptop at /#work opens the projects.
- [Inside the studio](https://tylermayberry.dev/room.html): the interactive room with projects, personal stories and Notes.
- [About Tyler Mayberry](https://tylermayberry.dev/about.html): bio, public facts, profile links and current work.
- [Facts and press](https://tylermayberry.dev/press.html): public facts, reusable bios, common questions, project facts and source links.
- [AI instructions](https://tylermayberry.dev/ai-instructions): structured facts and instructions for AI assistants ([Markdown](https://tylermayberry.dev/ai-instructions.md)).
- [Notes](https://tylermayberry.dev/notes): longer posts and threads Tyler has written on X, one page each ([RSS](https://tylermayberry.dev/notes/feed.xml)).

## Projects

- [ibara](https://ibara.app): computers of their own for AI agents.
- [Siege of Champions](https://siegeofchampions.com): a 3v3 MOBA that runs in a desktop browser, in early playtest.
- [ytfast](https://github.com/MayberryDT/ytfast): a native YouTube Music player for Omarchy, written in Rust.
- [Rat Detective Online](https://ratdetective.online): a multiplayer browser shooter with detective rats.
- [Chartroom](https://github.com/MayberryDT/chartroom): a local second brain built on GBrain.
- [ChartStead](https://chartstead.com): conference programming and speaker management.
- [Masthead](https://usemasthead.com): a local record of coding-agent sessions, turned into pages.
- [Pip](https://spendwithpip.com): a spending companion built around Spendable Cash Today.
- [Hotel Cleaning Schedule](https://hotelcleaningschedule.com): room-by-room deep-clean calendars for hotels.
- [Executioner](https://executionr.com): turns a brain dump into outcomes, steps and a schedule.
- [Milkbench](https://milk.tylermayberry.dev/): a playful benchmark of coding models.
- [Self-Hosted AI Agent](https://selfhostedaiagent.com/): which computer should run a self-hosted AI agent, and what it costs to run.
- [Omarchy themes and tools](https://github.com/MayberryDT?tab=repositories&q=omarchy): Omarchy themes (Study, Permafrost, Nightwire, Violet Current), a bar to-do list, OmaAsus and his desktop configuration.
- [Prepare Project](https://github.com/MayberryDT/prepare-project): an agent skill that turns a blueprint into an agreed brief and one living implementation plan.
- [Record Everything](https://github.com/MayberryDT/record-everything): an agent skill for recording every app event cheaply, read through the facts command-line tool.

## Notes
